title: The Stars Are Scaring Aquarius Right Now
script_text: Stop, Aquarius — Pluto is rewriting your entire identity right now and you must pay close attention. Your air element and ruling planet Uranus are generating intense electric energy, but today Pluto forms a powerful conjunction in your 1st House of Self, demanding radical honesty about who you are becoming. Meanwhile, the Sun in Virgo creates a tense square to Jupiter sitting in your 11th House of Friendships, putting your social circles under serious strain. In love, the Sun illuminates your 7th House of Partnerships — someone close to you is concealing a truth that's about to completely surface. Singles, you're magnetically drawn to someone unconventional who fearlessly challenges your worldview. Career-wise, an authority figure in your workplace may test your patience and limits this week. Avoid signing any binding contracts before Friday — your financial foundation needs full protection. Subscribe so you don't miss what's coming.
